crcPrototype.decision: DO NOT ADOPT from these measurements: correctness PASS, high-entropy benefit consistent, but low-entropy project no-regression gate not established. Keep source prototype separate for future same-production-build validation.
crcPrototype.rationale: Original emitted bundle decomposition identified high-entropy PNG CRC2618–2801ms of5973–6253ms encode. Indexed private CRC loop targets that measured cost; not a style-only edit. It does not address low-entropy ~1s encode dominated by deflate/Adler with CRC2–3ms.
crcPrototype.scope: Cause-driven CRC indexed-loop prototype, temporary only. Unobserved original frozen production Worker vs original bundle with only private CRC loop indexed. Original reply shape/bytes/transfer preserved. Fresh Worker constructor→main reply; fixture creation, digest/roundtrip validation and forced GC outside measurement. No full UI/recovery/clone/storage/native OS timings or worker thread CPU claim.

patch.scope: Temporary cause-driven CPU candidate only. Original emitted bundle changes one private CRC loop; no handler/codec parameter/reply/API change. Source prototype shows corresponding production TypeScript edit, not applied to repository.
patch.sourceBefore: for (const b of bytes) c = crcTable[(c ^ b) & 255] ^ (c >>> 8);
patch.sourceAfter: for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) c = crcTable[(c ^ bytes[i]) & 255] ^ (c >>> 8);
